race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3yo C&G Final (G1)
race.comment: ENJOY LIFE (2) suffered his first defeat in his ninth start last week but he still performed well for a 3m third after drawing wide and racing parked. Much better served by this barrier and he had overcome second row barriers to win his other three starts this time in. Should enjoy a soft run so can bounce back. LE CARDINAL (3) added to a series of wins and placings when he came from the outside to take out his semi by 3.4m last week. Hard to knock the consistency and the lower draw brings him right into contention. THE NITESHIFT (9) had to cover ground last week so was far from disgraced when third to LE CARDINAL. Good heat winner prior. Draws on the back line but if he gets the gaps he looks dangerous. MOST EXCITING (1) gets the same draw he had when he finished strongly along the sprint lane to win last week's semi, taking his strike rate at this circuit and distance to 50 per cent. History could repeat. CARDIGAN DAN (4) has been racing well from the back row so deserves respect.
